name: Anritsu Corporation
summary: Anritsu Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells electronic measurement instruments in Japan, the United States of America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Communications measurement, Products Quality Assurance, and Environmental Measurement segments. The company's test and measurement products include bit error rate tester and sampling oscilloscope; mobile/wireless communications measuring instruments, such as Bluetooth and WLAN testers, cable and antenna analyzers, channel emulators/fading simulators, conformance test systems, handset one box testers, land mobile radio products, passive intermodulation analyzers, shield boxes/cha…
